title: Act: Track round loading/error in App and render HeaderOverlay
description: Replace round useState with loading/error state, remove loose RoundBadge/Countdown, pass header prop to GameLayout.
acceptance_criteria: Given each of loading, error and ready round states, when App renders, then HeaderOverlay receives matching loading, error and round props
Given the GameLayout header slot, when App renders, then the header is passed through the header prop and no loose RoundBadge or Countdown remains

steps.action: Add const [roundError, setRoundError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined) and const [roundLoading, setRoundLoading] = useState(true). Change the effect to: getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch((e) => setRoundError(`Round status unavailable: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'request failed'}`)).finally(() => setRoundLoading(false)).
steps.code: getCurrentRound().then(setRound).catch(e => setRoundError(`Round status unavailable: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'request failed'}`)).finally(() => setRoundLoading(false))
steps.expected: State reflects pending, success and failure

steps.action: Delete the RoundBadge and Countdown lines and their imports. Import HeaderOverlay. Pass to GameLayout header={<HeaderOverlay worldTitle="The Boy's Room" round={round} loading={roundLoading} error={roundError} />}.
steps.expected: Header appears via GameLayout slot; no 'Round unavailable' text in App
